messages:
zoe: Dropping a compact design pass for the model catalog compare view. Main focuses: column density (more rows per view), badge affordances for perf/meta, and alternative wording for 'pin' to reduce confusion. figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/new-model-catalog

Diego: Love the density options. One ask: can we present a compact mode toggle? power users want 6-8 rows; default should stay comfy.

min: Compact toggle + keyboard shortcut (C) seems nice. but make sure contrast and hit targets remain >= 44px where actionable.

zoe: Agreed. Compact mode reduces row padding and hides secondary meta under a hover menu. We should surface the perf badge and version control always.

sean: Re: the perf badge, proposal: change flame -> 3-segment radial (micro-donut) that visually encodes percentile buckets. hover shows exact numbers. This avoids emoji semantics.

min: Good. Also proposal to include a small chevron for 'details' so screen reader users know there is an expanded panel. aria-expanded semantics on the row are important.

diego: About 'pin' wording testers consistently mixed up pin with bookmarking. I mocked 3 variants: A) "Anchor version" B) "Lock version" C) "Pin version (legacy)". Anchor was surprising but some users liked it because it implies spatial/placement semantics.

zoe: Hmm "Anchor" signals layout more than routing to me. What about "Hold version for route"? longer but explicit. Might be clunky in a tooltip.

sean: My gut: pick a short verb + helper line. Example: primary: "Anchor version" secondary: "Keeps this version on the route (overrides rollout)". We can A/B test anchor vs lock for support ticket reduction.

min: Accessibility checklist I want on PR: 1) each row has a logical heading and role=row 2) perf badge has aria-label like: "p95 latency 180ms" 3) compact toggle is a real button with aria-pressed 4) pin/anchor control has aria-describedby pointing to helper text 5) keyboard shortcut announcement via aria-live when toggled

zoe: For compact mode CSS hint: reduce row padding, collapse nonessential badges into a single meta pill, and tighten font-size to 13px. simple snippet:

```css
.compare-row.compact { padding:6px 8px; font-size:13px; }
.meta-pill { display:inline-flex; gap:6px; align-items:center; }
```

sean: perf thresholds suggestion: use p95 for badge, thresholds: green <200ms, amber 200-400ms, red >400ms. show exact p95 in tooltip and include sample size e.g., "p95: 185ms (n=120k tokens)" for context.

min: Also add a textual fallback for colorblind users: include an icon glyph variation and ensure badges have accessible names. don't rely on color alone.

diego: about the compare header stickiness when horizontally scrolling: propose sticky header + left-frozen column for the model name. this helps orientation in wide tables. need to account for responsive breakpoints.

zoe: UX note: when a version is anchored/fixed, show a subtle left rail summary that lists active anchors and their routes. includes an undo button. toast should be aria-live=polite.

sean: Analytics events: catalog.mode_toggle, catalog.anchor_clicked, catalog.anchor_tooltip_viewed. include properties: mode (compact/comfortable), variant (anchor/lock/pin), model_id, user_id.

min: microcopy for empty compare state: current is "No models selected". proposal: "No models selected  Choose models or anchor a version to start comparing." short alt: "No models  pick or anchor a version." testers preferred the verb "pick".

zoe: We'll run a small A/B with 3% traffic each for anchor vs lock vs pin (control). Goals: reduce help articles referencing "pin confusion" and improve first-run completion for compare flows.

sean: small implementation checklist: 1) compact mode CSS tokens 2) perf badge component with aria-label and hidden text 3) anchor control with aria-describedby and keyboard support 4) header sticky behavior inside scroll container 5) tests for keyboard nav and contrast

deply-bot: Build queued for branch feature/compare-compact-anchor (id: 1519)  running unit + accessibility checks. :gear:

min: FYI automated a11y check flagged low contrast for current green at 12px. propose color #15803d or add UI outline. I'll attach contrast sweep results in PR.

zoe: Timeline: target design sign-off by Tue, dev prototype by Thu, ship behind flag next week. I'll update figma and post final frames when ready. thanks team :sparkles:
